$comment: Ingest pipeline and operations FMEA (GAU-121; operations rows GAU-163). NASA SP-2016-6105 Rev 2 §6.4. Severity/likelihood 1-5; risk = S x L. residualLikelihood is after the mitigation. verifiedBy = exact test names proving the mitigation; gap = what is still missing. Checked by `npm run verify`.

rows.failureMode: Feed down or HTTP error
rows.effect: IMF and plasma inputs age; a naive system would keep serving the last value as live
rows.detection: Measurement-age freshness tier; source status lastSeen from data time
rows.mitigation: Carry at most 15 min, then flag stale (tier 3); other sources continue in parallel
verifiedBy: ingest tick: no jitter between fetches, and an over-age readout is dropped (GAU-44)
latest feed: points older than 15 min are served flagged stale (GAU-15)

rows.failureMode: Hangs or responds slowly
rows.effect: Tick stalls; all data ages behind one slow source
rows.detection: Per-stage latency and timeout counters (/api/system/pipeline)
rows.mitigation: Parallel fetch, per-source time budget, previous value kept
verifiedBy: pipeline timer: a stage past its timeout is abandoned and counted
tick reports per-stage latency, and sources are fetched in parallel

rows.failureMode: Tick overruns the 5 s interval
rows.effect: Overlapping ticks publish out of order and hide the slow stage
rows.detection: skippedTicks counter
rows.mitigation: Skip a tick while one is running
verifiedBy: interval never stacks a tick on one still running

rows.failureMode: Format or field change (e.g. temperature read as velocity)
rows.effect: Wrong physical values presented as measurements
rows.detection: Row validation per adapter; source unhealthy
rows.mitigation: Strict parsing; malformed rows rejected, never coerced
verifiedBy: NOAA: RTSW active spacecraft, native GSE, UTC time, no temperature-as-velocity (GAU-48, GAU-51, GAU-56)
ESA: parses nested and flat HAPI B_NEC rows and rejects malformed ones (GAU-50)

rows.failureMode: Fill, blank or null values
rows.effect: Coerced to 0 and published as real data
rows.detection: Range and type checks per value
rows.mitigation: Treated as missing; row or channel skipped
verifiedBy: MMS: fill-valued components are rejected rather than zeroed
GOES: newest valid sample of the S-scale channel; fill and null flux skipped (GAU-112)
Kyoto Dst: newest valid hour, read as UTC; blanks and bad times skipped (GAU-116)

rows.failureMode: Zone-less time read in host local time (UTC+8)
rows.effect: Data shifted by 8 h; freshness wrong
rows.detection: Unit tests run in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur
rows.mitigation: Zone-less tags parsed as UTC; invalid rejected
verifiedBy: NOAA: zone-less SWPC time_tags are read as UTC, invalid ones rejected
CSV rows with unparseable times are skipped, and compact times are UTC (GAU-114)

rows.failureMode: Down, timeout, missing route or malformed answer
rows.effect: A naive client invents a forecast or errors to the UI
rows.detection: Client validation and timeout
rows.mitigation: Explicit 'unavailable' with a reason; no number shown
verifiedBy: inference server failures become unavailable with no URL in the reason (GAU-111)
no inference server: forecast is an explicit unavailable, never a number (GAU-111)

rows.failureMode: Model file missing or corrupt
rows.effect: Broken deployment silently reads as 'no model deployed'
rows.detection: Load error surfaced in the unavailable reason and /health
rows.mitigation: Promotion gate; load failures reported as such
verifiedBy: Kp model unit tests (python)

rows.failureMode: Skill degrades in operation (drift, regime change)
rows.effect: Forecasts worse than persistence while still served
rows.detection: Live forecast_skill TPM: each served forecast scored against observed Kp 3 h later, rolling MAE vs persistence
rows.mitigation: Held-out gate at promotion; red TPM when live skill falls below persistence
verifiedBy: FMEA FM-09: live forecast skill is scored against observed Kp and compared with persistence (GAU-122)

rows.failureMode: Write fails (disk full, permissions)
rows.effect: History silently lost; persist stage reported ok
rows.detection: failedWrites counter; persist-stage errors in /api/system/pipeline
rows.mitigation: Point still served from memory; failure surfaced, not swallowed
verifiedBy: FMEA: a failed telemetry write is counted and reported, and the tick still publishes (GAU-121)
FMEA: best-effort appends never reject (no unhandled rejection); strict appends do; both count (GAU-121)

rows.failureMode: Corrupt or torn line (crash mid-write)
rows.effect: Whole fallback read returns nothing
rows.detection: lastSkippedLines counter
rows.mitigation: Bad lines skipped, rest served
verifiedBy: bedrock skips corrupt and torn lines instead of returning nothing (GAU-117)

rows.failureMode: Restart (crash, deploy, reboot)
rows.effect: Memory buffer empty: history lost and forecast blind for 6 h
rows.detection: Startup log: points reloaded
rows.mitigation: Last 24 h reloaded from bedrock before the worker starts; launchd KeepAlive restarts the process
verifiedBy: restart reload fills an empty buffer once, in order, and never duplicates (GAU-117)

rows.failureMode: Sleeps, loses power or fails
rows.effect: Whole service down, fallback included: single point of failure
rows.detection: Pipeline verdict 'stalled' after 3 missed ticks; HUD shows STALLED; the awake guard texts the phone at 20% and 10% battery
rows.mitigation: Auto-restart on wake; the awake guard keeps the host running with the lid closed down to 10% battery; a process or release failure on this host fails over to the cold-standby fallback (FM-20 to FM-24). No standby host
verifiedBy: pipeline timer: status follows data age and loop liveness
replayed 57→2% drain: warn from 20%, critical from 10%
out of restarts and still down: fails over to the fallback and texts the phone
rows.gap: Host loss (power, hardware, OS) is unmitigated: the fallback runs on the same host, so it goes down too. Needs a second node with at least 16 GB RAM as a warm standby, with data replication and Tailscale failover (docs/STABILITY.md)

rows.failureMode: Disk fills (98% full observed 2026-10-11)
rows.effect: All writes fail; services may crash
rows.detection: disk_free TPM (amber < 10 GB, red < 3 GB) in /api/system/tpm, /health and `npm run tpm`
rows.mitigation: Threshold alert before writes fail; allowlisted disk-cleanup
verifiedBy: FMEA FM-14: free disk is read from the data volume and graded (GAU-122)
rows.gap: `npm run tpm` is not yet scheduled (launchd + phone alert): needs approval for a launchctl change

rows.failureMode: Unbounded growth
rows.effect: OOM, swap storm, crash
rows.detection: Bounded buffers by construction
rows.mitigation: Ring buffers and capped windows
verifiedBy: caps coupling window length to prevent unbounded memory growth
canonical feed keeps a fixed-size ring buffer

rows.failureMode: Skew: points stamped in the future
rows.effect: Wrong forecast window; data looks fresher than it is
rows.detection: Window and freshness checks against now
rows.mitigation: Future points excluded from the forecast window
verifiedBy: forecast window: last 6 h of measured points, one per minute (GAU-115)

rows.failureMode: Abuse: floods, malicious payloads, credential stuffing
rows.effect: Service degraded for operators
rows.detection: CyberTiger signatures, rate counters
rows.mitigation: Block, rate-limit, auto-block on auth failures
verifiedBy: blocks malicious signature and places IP on blocklist
rate limits after max requests within configured window
auth failure threshold auto-blocks IP

rows.failureMode: Stale or missing data shown as nominal
rows.effect: Operator acts on false 'all clear'
rows.detection: UI view-model checks freshness and tier
rows.mitigation: Unknown rendered as unknown/STALE/NO_TELEMETRY
verifiedBy: HUD never shows stale or missing data as fresh
measured drivers come only from current, complete measurements (GAU-114)

rows.failureMode: Unverified or broken release deployed to the live checkout
rows.effect: Live service runs code that fails tests or does not start
rows.detection: Tag annotation must carry VERIFY PASSED; post-deploy TPM health check
rows.mitigation: Verified-tag-only deploys from origin/main; automatic rollback when unhealthy; manual rollback
verifiedBy: deploy: only verified tags on main to a clean checkout (GAU-123)
deploy: an unhealthy release rolls back automatically (GAU-123)
rollback: returns to the previous healthy release (GAU-123)

rows.failureMode: Stops running (crashes, unloaded, launchd stops scheduling it)
rows.effect: Nothing watches live: a hung service is not restarted, no failover happens, no battery or memory alerts; launchd KeepAlive still restarts a crashed process
rows.detection: The guard touches guard.heartbeat every run; Argo restarts uk.lightbound.gauss-awake when it is over 5 min old, at most 3 times an hour, then alerts (tools/argo/watch.go)
rows.mitigation: Mutual watch: the guard restarts Argo and mesh-heal when their state goes stale, and Argo restarts the guard
verifiedBy: fresh peers: no restarts, guard heartbeat written
stale Argo and mesh-heal: both restarted
rows.gap: Argo's side (restart a stale guard, stop after 3 an hour) is tested only in Go (tools/argo/watch_test.go: TestWatchRestartsStaleAndMissingButSkipsUnloaded, TestWatchStopsKickingACrashLoopAndAlerts), which `npm run verify` does not ingest yet; if Argo and the guard both stop, or the host does (FM-13), nothing watches

rows.failureMode: Corrupt, cut short, or stale: names a checkout that is gone or has changed since it was prepared (PR #129: a path with a space was cut at the space)
rows.effect: Failover silently can't happen, or starts a fallback that is not what the record says
rows.detection: The record's sha, path and time are validated, and a ready fallback also needs both plists and a built site; `status` and `check` show 'none prepared (warning)'
rows.mitigation: An invalid record reads as no fallback: out of restarts the guard only alerts and never boots live out with nothing in its place; re-pointing the fallback drops the record before the checkout changes
verifiedBy: fallback status: ready although its path has a space
dev refuses the fallback checkout (path with a space)
a corrupt, cut-short or orphaned fallback record reads as none prepared: no half failover, still alerts
deploy: a fallback that fails to rebuild stops the deploy and is not left marked ready
rows.gap: Nothing texts when the standby goes bad: it shows in status and check, or as a 'keeps failing' alert only once the failover is needed

rows.failureMode: Fallback code too old for what live has written to the data, .env and accounts it shares
rows.effect: Failover serves errors: the fallback starts and answers /health but fails on data a newer release wrote
rows.detection: The guard keeps health-checking the fallback (backend /health, site root) with capped restarts and a phone alert
rows.mitigation: Each deploy refreshes the fallback to the release live was just running, so it is one release behind when live was healthy at deploy time
verifiedBy: deploy: fallback refreshed to the previous version; npm ci only for the new fallback (live's lockfile unchanged)
fallback plists: live's ports, URLs, data and .env; prepare never loads them
on fallback: the guard restarts the fallback, never fails over again
rows.gap: No check that the previous release reads data the current one wrote (no data schema version), and /health does not read data; when live was unhealthy at deploy time the fallback is kept and can be several releases behind

rows.failureMode: Restart loop, or flapping between live and fallback
rows.effect: Services restarted over and over, the phone flooded, memory churn on the 8 GB host; live and fallback swapping back and forth
rows.detection: Restart log (watch-kicks) and the 'keeps failing' phone alert, sent with argo notify -every 1h
rows.mitigation: Two failed health checks in a row before any restart; at most 3 restarts per job in a rolling hour, then alert only; failover is one-way (on the fallback the guard only restarts the fallback; failback is a person running `fallback off`); the guard stands aside during a deploy, and a lock older than 30 min stops counting
verifiedBy: backend down once: wait for a second failure
a recovery resets the strike count
4th restart in an hour: alert instead of kicking
restarts over an hour old don't count: restarted again, no alert
on fallback: the guard restarts the fallback, never fails over again
on fallback and out of restarts: alerts only, no restart loop, no flip back to live
the guard leaves the services alone during a deploy
a deploy lock older than 30 min no longer silences the guard

rows.failureMode: Leaves no fallback
rows.effect: The next live failure has no standby: out of restarts the guard can only alert
rows.detection: Deploy prints a warning when there is no fallback to refresh; `status` and `check` show 'none prepared (warning)'
rows.mitigation: Deploy refreshes the fallback to the outgoing healthy release before switching, and stops if it can't; when the release and the rollback both fail it fails over and keeps the fallback rather than replacing it with an unhealthy live
verifiedBy: deploy: fallback refreshed to the previous version; npm ci only for the new fallback (live's lockfile unchanged)
deploy of a bad commit: rolls back by itself and texts the phone; fallback is the last good one
deploy and rollback both fail: switches to the fallback (kept, not replaced by an unhealthy live)
deploy: a fallback that fails to rebuild stops the deploy and is not left marked ready
deploy with no fallback prepared or given: warns, deploys, leaves none
fallback status: none prepared is a warning
rows.gap: With no fallback prepared and no path given, deploy warns and goes ahead, leaving none; a failed refresh of the current fallback stops the deploy but leaves no fallback until `fallback prepare` succeeds
